q1_issues.issue: Past is wrapped only around the LocatedIn atom while the clause's other categorical atoms (Member sk_atmosphere_1 atmosphere / different) are left unwrapped, whereas the tense rule states the past wrapper applies to every categorical atom the clause yields — the parse is internally inconsistent about whether this clause is tensed.
"a different kind of atmosphere" is flattened to an atmosphere that is different, dropping the kind-level layer of "kind of" and the implicit standard "different" is measured against.

q2_gaps: "kind / sort / type of N" NPs — the instruction set has no representation for a kind-denoting NP layer over a referent (a sub-kind of atmosphere rather than an atmosphere that is different)

relational "different" with an unstated standard — the Comparatives section covers More/SameDegree/Degree with an explicit or forKind standard, but not an anaphoric "different (from what came before)"
notes: The existential witness, definite typing of "the headquarters", the pluralia-tantum lemma headquarters, and the static LocatedIn for an entity-attached "in" PP are all correct. Property on a minted witness correctly uses Member rather than Inheritance.
